data.title: Ethereum Glamsterdam Upgrade Delayed Over Smart Contract Security Risks
data.description: Ethereum developers have postponed the Glamsterdam upgrade on the Hoodi testnet after researchers identified potential security risks involving existing smart contracts, leaving the network’s next major development milestone without a confirmed activation date. The decision comes as ETH trades under $2,400, with the token losing around 0.5%.The Ethereum Foundation announced ...
